key_events: Haaland goal 34' (header from De Bruyne cross)
Liverpool high press forced 3 turnovers in City half
City dominated possession but struggled to break Liverpool block
TAA switched to inverted role in 2nd half
tactical_notes: Liverpool sat deeper than usual, absorbing City's possession and hitting on transitions. Slot adjusted to a 4-4-2 mid-block in the second half. City struggled with width against Liverpool's compact shape.

key_events: Madrid lethal on 3 counter-attacks despite low possession
tactical_notes: Classic Ancelotti game management. Madrid conceded possession intentionally and waited for transition moments. Mbappé and Vinícius exploited City's high defensive line repeatedly. City's inverted FBs left gaps in wide areas.

key_events: Liverpool's high press suffocated Madrid build-up
tactical_notes: Liverpool's pressing was the decisive factor. Slot's team pressed Madrid's double pivot relentlessly, preventing any meaningful build-up. Madrid's transition game was neutralized by Liverpool's recovery speed. TAA controlled tempo from the right.
